Asset packs are zip files with checked assets from MakeHuman and the asset repositories. You can download these to quickly get up and running with a basic set of assets.

MPFB2 users will want at least the “Makehuman system assets”.

## Releases
- Release 2024-06-23 - Two asset packs with poses [Poses 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/poses01.html) (with sitting poses) and [Poses 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/poses02.html) (with sports poses) have been added. You need a nightly build from 2024-06-23 or later to load these.
- Release 2023-07-17 - Update [MakeHuman system assets](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html) to include missing eye textures.
- Release 2023-05-20 - New CC0 skins packs with [natural female](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins01.html), [natural male](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html) and [non-natural](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins03.html) skins.
- Release 2023-04-13 - Two new asset packs [Glasses 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/glasses01.html) and [Glasses 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/glasses02.html)
- Release 2022-12-18 - Not a release per se, but there’s a now a secondary mirror listed at the bottom of this page.

## Available asset packs
- [MakeHuman system assets](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html): System assets, such as proxies, eyes, teeth…
- [System clothes materials 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/system_clothes_materials01.html): Extra materials for system clothes
- [System hair materials 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/system_hair_materials01.html): Extra materials for system hair

- [Skins 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins01.html): A set of natural female skins
- [Skins 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html): A set of natural male skins
- [Skins 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins03.html): A set of non-natural skins

- [Dress 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/dress01.html): A set of female gowns and dresses
- [Eyebrows 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/eyebrows01.html): A set of high-res eyebrows by Mindfront
- [Eyelashes 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/eyelashes01.html): A set of high-res eyebrows by Mindfront
- [Glasses 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/glasses01.html): A set of glasses
- [Gloves 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/gloves01.html): A set of gloves
- [Masks 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/masks01.html): A set of masks
- [Pants 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/pants01.html): A set of pants
- [Shirts 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shirts01.html): A set of t-shirts, sweaters and tops
- [Shoes 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shoes01.html): A set of shoes and boots
- [Underwear 01](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/underwear01.html): A set of female underwear
- [Underwear 04](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/underwear04.html): A set of socks

- [Dress 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/dress02.html): A set of female gowns and dresses by Elvaerwyn
- [Dress 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/dress03.html): A set of female gowns and dresses
- [Glasses 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/glasses02.html): A set of glasses
- [Pants 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/pants02.html): A set of long-legged pants
- [Pants 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/pants03.html): A set of short legged pants swimming trunks
- [Shirts 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shirts03.html): A set of short sleeved shirts, tunics and tops
- [Shoes 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shoes02.html): A set of low shoes, sneakers and sandals
- [Shoes 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/shoes03.html): A set of boots
- [Underwear 02](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/underwear02.html): A set of female underwear and bikinis
- [Underwear 03](https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/underwear03.html): A set of underwear and swimwear

## Secondary mirror
Please only use this if the download links on the subpages above do not work. The mirror has a much tighter traffic quota and there’s a risk it might get shut down if overloaded.

The secondary mirror is [here](http://files2.makehumancommunity.org/)

web.description:
# Asset Packs
Asset packs are zip files with checked assets from MakeHuman and the asset repositories. You can download these to quickly get up and running with a basic set of assets.

MPFB2 users will want at least the “Makehuman system assets”.

## Releases
